DIAGNOSIS READY: Asthma (post-infectious/reactive airway disease)

The symptoms of nocturnal and exertional cough, wheezing, and dyspnea following an upper respiratory infection are classic for reactive airway disease, not pyelonephritis which affects the kidneys.
